leveling.introText: Set a pace that rewards regulars without turning every message into a transaction.
leveling.settingsDetail: These controls apply to every member in this server.
leveling.levelUpPlaceholder: Leave blank for Niko's default message
leveling.channelsDetail: Excluded channels never award XP, and ticket channels are always excluded automatically.
leveling.voiceHint: Earn XP for every minute spent in a voice channel. AFK channels never count.
leveling.excludedHint: Select the channels that should never award XP.
leveling.rewardsDetail: Niko grants these roles automatically when a member reaches the level. The same list is editable with /leveling panel in Discord.
leveling.emptyBody: Pick a level and the role Niko should grant when a member reaches it.
leveling.rewardsNote: Members keep roles they have already earned, so removing a reward here stops Niko from awarding it but does not take it back.
leveling.incompleteReward: Every level reward needs both a level and a role. Finish or remove the incomplete row.
